container: Animal testing remains one of the most difficult ethical debates in science. Supporters argue that regulated studies can reveal treatments and protect humans and animals from disease. Critics respond that animals experience pain and fear, and that results may not reliably predict human outcomes. Ethical research should use alternatives, such as cell models and computer simulations, whenever possible. When animal studies are necessary, researchers must minimize suffering, justify each procedure, and provide humane care. Society should demand transparency and independent oversight. Scientific progress matters, but compassion and responsibility must guide every decision about living beings.
